chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Xian Ch.74: Death – Self-Harm, Drowning, and a Mud-Vomiting Miracle
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang spirals into self-harm after the massacre. Bodies pile up. Then the Fool, drowned and stiff, vomits lake mud and wakes up. A brutal, hollow aftermath in the Dao-Twisted World.
og_title: Li Huowang Spiral and a Mud-Vomiting Miracle – Chapter 74
og_description: After the battle, grief and self-loathing consume the survivors. A grim inventory of loss, a single, grotesque fluke of a resurrection.
twitter_title: A Grim Chapter: Li Huowang Hurts Himself, the Fool Vomits Mud Back to Life
twitter_description: Li Huowang stabs his own hand. The Fool drowns. Then he vomits mud and wakes up. There’s no glory here, just a brutal, hollow quiet after the storm.
